name: Doctors Without Borders
mission: Doctors Without Borders, USA (DWB-USA) was founded in 1990 in New York City to raise funds, create awareness, recruit field staff, and advocate with the United Nations and US government on humanitarian concerns. Doctors Without Borders/Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international medical humanitarian organization that provides aid in nearly 60 countries to people whose survival is threatened by violence, neglect, or catastrophe, primarily due to armed conflict, epidemics, malnutrition, exclusion from health care, or natural disasters.

Financial reviews highlight a <cite id="1">Program expense ratio of 84.7%</cite> and a <cite id="1">fundraising efficiency of $0.15 per $1 raised</cite> [1]. Independent evaluation reflects these fiscal controls, resulting in an <cite id="1">Overall Score of 97.0/100 from Charity Navigator</cite> [1]. Field operations emphasize immediate life-saving care, where direct medical relief efforts have accounted for <cite id="3">4,000 surgeries performed</cite> during major disaster responses [3].
rich_narrative.summary: Doctors Without Borders provides rapid emergency medical aid to populations facing catastrophic armed conflict, epidemic outbreaks, and natural disasters [1]. Operating as a direct service humanitarian entity, the organization delivers urgent clinical care and medical research where local health systems have collapsed [1]. In FY2024, the charity managed <cite id="2">Total Revenue of $767,362,916</cite> to fuel its emergency operations across global crisis zones [2]. The organization earns strong third-party evaluations, highlighted by <cite id="1">an Overall Score of 97.0/100 from Charity Navigator</cite> [1]. Operational strength is reinforced by high financial efficiency, maintaining a <cite id="1">Program expense ratio of 84.7%</cite> [1]. Funding supports critical direct interventions, such as complex field responses where teams have completed <cite id="3">4,000 surgeries in crisis zones</cite> [3]. While the global scope is vast, the organization maintains efficient operations with <cite id="1">fundraising costs of $0.15 per $1 raised</cite> [1].
